actions.summary: Supply the actual unresolved official-source bytes through the controlled handoff, with source identity, provenance and permission to retain them.
external_prerequisites: authorized access to the identified official publisher or custodian
the exact source identity and acquisition request for each supplied artifact
evidence_required: source URL or custodian reference and acquisition timestamp
actions.completion_effect: Permits controlled import and re-verification only; it does not activate a legal source.

actions.summary: An identified independent legal reviewer must inspect the exact source bytes and sign the seven-topic authority, completeness and content decisions.
external_prerequisites: eligible controlled-import receipts from OA-01
reviewer organization, active public key and policy registration with proof of possession
separation from the importer role
evidence_required: signed canonical decision envelope per reviewed topic
actions.completion_effect: Permits source-lifecycle eligibility re-evaluation only; it does not activate any source.

actions.summary: A trusted applicability reviewer must sign the effective period, sector, population and exception scope bound to the exact reviewed source version.
external_prerequisites: completed source-content decision from OA-02
independent applicability reviewer identity and active signing key
the exact source version and citation anchors
evidence_required: exact effective-period, sector and population scope
actions.completion_effect: Permits applicability-gate re-verification only; it does not activate a source or rule.

actions.summary: Two distinct trusted reviewers must independently attest the exact numeric or categorical parameter payload and its source/applicability bindings.
external_prerequisites: eligible source and applicability decisions from OA-02 and OA-03
two active reviewer identities from distinct duties
exact parameter candidate hash and derivation citations
evidence_required: two distinct signed canonical attestation envelopes
exact parameter candidate and content SHA-256
source, period, sector and population bindings
actions.completion_effect: Permits dual-attestation and eligibility re-verification only; it does not activate a parameter.

actions.summary: Human authors must complete the blank RuleSpec and golden cases, and distinct trusted reviewers must approve semantics and expected results against exact hashes.
external_prerequisites: eligible sources and dual-attested parameters
RuleSpec author, legal reviewer and independent golden-result reviewer
completed nonblank cases covering required scenarios and boundaries
evidence_required: signed expected result for every golden case
mutation report bound to the approved RuleSpec and golden set
actions.completion_effect: Permits RuleSpec lifecycle re-verification only; it does not activate a rule or create a finding.

groups.title: Payslip visual review, dual annotation and adjudication

actions.summary: After license and PII eligibility are established, two blind annotators and a distinct adjudicator must visually inspect the exact payslip revision and sign the locked result.
external_prerequisites: document license or authorization and approved PII-handling scope
verified visual rendering of the exact immutable document bytes
two independent annotators and a separate adjudicator with active signing keys
evidence_required: locked revision signature bound to document and annotation hashes
actions.completion_effect: Permits locked-ground-truth re-verification for the authorized document only; it does not authorize other customer-data reads.

actions.summary: Deliver the actual deterministic evidence-package bytes to an identified independent auditor and obtain a signed receipt plus independent byte-verification decision.
external_prerequisites: final deterministic evidence package and detached verifier
identified auditor with active signing key and agreed delivery channel
auditor access to the actual package bytes
evidence_required: independent verified or rejected decision bound to the received bytes
actions.completion_effect: Completes external evidence handoff verification only; it does not authorize production delivery.

groups.title: Isolated Supabase, managed identity and storage

actions.summary: Provide a dedicated nonproduction Supabase target, managed identity issuer/key source and private storage tenancy under approved external ownership and access controls.
external_prerequisites: authorized managed-platform account and isolated nonproduction project
approved identity issuer, key-rotation policy and session-state service
private object-store tenancy and scoped service credentials
evidence_required: project and environment identity without secret values
signed issuer metadata and key-rotation receipt
actions.completion_effect: Permits isolated managed-environment verification only; it does not authorize deployment, remote production migration or live provider use.

actions.summary: Run the untrusted parser in an approved platform isolation primitive and sign evidence of OS-level process, filesystem, network and resource containment.
external_prerequisites: supported sandbox platform with an approved isolation policy
security operator authorized to inspect containment and resource controls
noncustomer adversarial fixtures
actions.completion_effect: Permits parser-isolation re-verification on the approved platform only; it does not enable customer processing.

actions.summary: Provision an approved off-host immutable destination, transfer actual encrypted bytes, and perform an independently witnessed restore and reconciliation drill.
external_prerequisites: approved off-host custody provider and retention policy
managed encryption-key ownership and rotation policy
authorized source inventory and restore target
evidence_required: destination receipt bound to exact byte hashes
restored-byte hash comparison and audit-continuity proof
actions.completion_effect: Permits off-host custody verification only; it does not prove production RPO/RTO or authorize delivery.

actions.summary: The data controller, privacy/security owner and authorized customer representative must approve the exact dataset, purpose, retention, access roles and stop conditions for Customer Shadow.
external_prerequisites: documented legal basis and customer authorization for the exact dataset
privacy and security risk approval
approved retention, deletion, incident and revocation procedures
independent operational reviewer and kill-switch owner
evidence_required: signed authorization bound to dataset manifest and purpose
actions.completion_effect: Permits a separate authorization-gate re-verification only; it does not authorize Customer Shadow or enable customer processing by itself.

non_claims: Every action is a genuinely human or external prerequisite; routine local engineering is excluded.
Completing an action permits only the named gate to be re-verified and never causes automatic activation.
No path, hash, prepared package or generated test signature is treated as human review, external delivery or receipt.
All zero and NO truth values remain unchanged until genuine evidence is verified through the canonical workflow.
